hints.title: Connected Component Partition
hints.text: Nodes in the same connected component can reach each other. Nodes in different components cannot.

hints.title: Component Sizes
hints.text: Compute the size of each connected component using disjoint set union or graph traversal.

hints.title: Complement Counting
hints.text: Total possible pairs is n * (n - 1) // 2. Subtract the number of reachable pairs sum(c * (c - 1) // 2) across all components.

hints.title: Component Size Pair Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: Union-find with size tracking runs in nearly linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking reachability between all O(n^2) pairs directly takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent and size arrays take O(n) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate calculates unreachable pairs via total_pairs - reachable_pairs in O(1) arithmetic.
